messages:
maya: Quick mid-quarter OKR signal — please drop one-line statuses for your milestones by EOD. Sheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/okr-midq. Shipped: runtime autoscale v2 canary + docs. Slipped: Dedicated capacity plan (Q2 -> Q3), Private on-prem pilot blocked on certs. Owners: Lee/runtime, Jon/dedicated, Ashley/private. Need CR pings and procurement follow-up.
lee: runtime canary looks green on small traffic, latency stable. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/412 — needs one more review. Queued e2e.
jon: dedicated capacity plan slipped — vendor quotes delayed. Working with procurement, ETA next week. Will update sheet. Blocker: final cost numbers from vendor.
sam: I can help with cost model once quotes land. Also have a small perf fix for runtime that may reduce GPU requirements (PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/418).
ashley: private on-prem pilot blocked by cert renewal in staging — eng-security needs HSM access. Opened ticket SEC-219 to track.
maya: Ok, owners confirmed. Lee -> get CR merged; Jon -> procurement follow-up with vendor; Ashley -> SEC-219 and certs. Fallback idea: cloud-only pilot if certs delay.
lee: will ping reviewers now. @sam @ashley tagging for perf/cert impacts. :thumbsup:
jon: procurement meeting Wed 10am PT, inviting Sam. If numbers are off we may need to trim Dedicated launch scope.
sam: attending Wed. I'll bring cost sims. Also pinging infra-provision team — @ops-team need ETA on rack availability for the dedicated pool.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment runtime-autoscale-v2 started at 1839991200, 3/3 instances healthy.
maya: Next steps: everyone drop 1-line in the sheet + mark blockers; Lee merge or revert by EOD if no reviews; Jon update procurement row after Wed; Ashley track SEC-219. I'll compile an exec-friendly update.
lee: one more CR in flight, @jon can you review perf numbers? If not merged by 6pm I'll queue a temporary revert.
ashley: SEC-219 assigned to me and eng-security, ETA Fri EOD, will update the ticket and post here.
sam: noted. PR #418 ready; I'll add perf numbers in the description. Quick eval shows ~8% token-cost reduction if patch holds.
maya: thanks — quick follow-up: who owns customer comms if Dedicated slips? @sam?
jon: I can draft internal comm for sales; Sam can prepare cost-impact slides. Maya — should I draft a customer-facing note too or wait?
maya: hold off on customer-facing until dates firm. Internal comms first (Jon).
lee: ack. I will chase reviewers and post status here by 5pm.
maya: perfect. If blockers remain after Friday we'll escalate to infra leadership. Thanks all. :heart:
